+# Reviewed document search implementation plan
+
+Goal: Recoverable research titles, IDs and ordinary prose must be searchable even when no VA/field literal occurs. Current real evidence: the title of recovered T025_DREAM_CLEARDAZO_GUARD_CONTRAST_20261015.md returns zero results.
+Architecture: Search only reviewed Markdown destinations admitted by the recovery ledger after existing source-byte verification. Add explicitly noncanonical document-match records and a generated document overview; keep current symbol/field/relation/correction/call behavior intact.
+Spec: Active user objective: human/AI Japanese and address/field lookup reaches the same evidence.
+Constraints: stdlib, no original game/research folder or network dependencies, no new source acquisition, historical/partial qualifiers retained, no promotion into canonical facts.
+
+- [x] Add failing synthetic tests for a document with no hex literals: full title, body-only Japanese, research ID and filename find a bounded cited excerpt with path/hash/inclusive lines and recovery limitations; absent matches remain absent.
+- [x] Extend tools/reference.py/test_reference.py only: include deduplicated source-backed Markdown document records in load/search; bound ordinary matching to one cited excerpt per matching document (default cap20, documented) without returning entire bodies. Filename/title hits point to heading lines; body hits point to actual matching lines. Keep kind=document_match and historical-text-match confidence.
+- [x] Generate reference/DOCUMENTS.md with document title/source links and coverage/limitations; link it from reference/README.md. No canonical endpoint/type/meaning discovery.
+- [ ] Validate bad path/hash remains rejected, ensure title/ID/body-only search in human CLI and JSON and fresh clone. Register generated overview and any runtime artifact in publication gate/allowlist, update UPDATING.md, then verify remote readback.
+
+User has already authorized the same retrieval goal, autonomous work and agents. This fixes a demonstrated retrieval gap rather than expanding the research scope.
+
+Review: observed RED on the demonstrated no-hex retrieval gap; 41 reference +12 sync tests pass; independent review found no retrieval defect. Real filename query returns the previously inaccessible reviewed title with exact line/SHA/limitations. Final publication/readback receipt is recorded in the associated PR.

+## [CONFIRMED-TARGET] load / play path
+- `openAudioCore` first diverts `ogg` to OggDecoder and `mp3` to DirectShow. All other extensions/no-extension cases fall into the DirectMusic branch.
+- The DirectMusic branch resolves the filename again, converts the resolved narrow string to wide text with `MultiByteToWideChar`, then invokes loader vtable `+0x38` with `CLSID_DirectMusicSegment`, `IID_IDirectMusicSegment8`, the path, and output segment pointer.

+- Playback later goes through an `IDirectMusicPerformance8` instance and segment pointer; the performance call at vtable `+0xB4` uses flags including `0x4000`, consistent with the DirectMusic segment-play path.

+## [CONFIRMED-TARGET] reset / missing-file behavior
+- Literal `a_system/reset.mid` is wired into a special DirectMusic reset path guarded by target global byte `0x8797CB`; it is separate from ordinary MP3/OGG transport.

+## 15. Pre-draw index upper-bound edge
+[CONFIRMED-TARGET / ENGINE-BUG COMPAT]
+- randomev75/31のturn1固定乱数はpushRand後に `while(value > count(@pool))` で再抽選するため、`value == count(@pool)` を受理する。
+- targetのstring-variable operation registryは `shuffle=40 (0x28)`、`index=41 (0x29)`。dispatcherはengine `+0x1EEF70` registryをlookupし、op41をhandler VA `0x4B05EF` へ送る。
+- 非empty listのnative `index(list,i,dst)` は要素数Nに対し **i<0なら0、0<=i<Nならi、i>=NならN-1** へclampする。handler `0x4B06FF..0x4B073F` で28-byte element vector長をNへ変換し、`cmp i,N / jl` のfalse側で `dec N`、続いてnegative clampを行う。
+- 従って `index(list,count(list),dst)` は **末尾要素を返す**。pre-drawの `rand==count` はinvalid/emptyではなく末尾へfoldされる。
+- さらにpre-drawは数値index同士の重複だけを排除するため、N-1とNは別indexとして同時採用され得るが、両方とも同じ末尾要素へ解決する。randomev75/31の「5候補重複なし」はstrict実装上 **要素レベルでは保証されない**。
+- `pushRand` はregistry op14、handler VA `0x4AEDDA`。native random core `0x40ED80` にlower=0/upper=100を渡し、MSVC型LCG outputを1/32768倍してtruncateするため **0..99**。
+- pre-drawがN<100の場合、reject条件が `value>N` なので受理値0..Nは条件付きで等確率。index clamp後は末尾だけN-1/Nの2値がfoldされ、1回の抽選では末尾要素の確率が `2/(N+1)`、その他各要素が `1/(N+1)` になる。
+- Golden: N>=2でraw index N-1/N/N+1/-1を比較し、N-1とNが同一末尾、N+1も末尾、-1が先頭になることを固定する。pre-drawではraw N-1/Nを同時採用して同一要素へ解決するケースも保持する。

+## 16. Native RNG / shuffle contract
+[CONFIRMED-TARGET]
+- CRT rand core VA `0x5B6EAB`: `state = state*0x343FD + 0x269EC3 (mod 2^32)`、return `(state>>16)&0x7FFF`。stateはCRT thread data `+0x14`。
+- range helper VA `0x40ED80`: `floor(rand()/32768 * (upper-lower)) + lower`。定数VA `0x63B080` はdouble `1/32768`。
+- srand相当 VA `0x5B6E99` はstateへseedを直接保存する。direct callerは4系統を確認し、GetTickCount reseedだけでなくmap側seed値を使う一時的reseedも存在する。strict replayでは「プロセス開始時に1回seed」だけでは不十分（詳細§17）。
+- `shuffle` op40 handler VA `0x4B044F` はstring-vectorへ `0x479740 -> 0x479A30` を適用。要素サイズ28 byte。i=1..N-1でj=random%i+1相当（実装はrand拡張値を `(i+1)` で剰余）を選び、element iとjをswapするforward Fisher-Yates。N<=32767なら各stepでCRT randを1回消費するため、51要素poolでは50回消費。
+- 以上からrandom-event turn1のshuffle/pre-drawは他subsystemと同一CRT RNG streamを共有する。完全なseed-to-event再現にはGetTickCount reseed地点と、それ以前のrand消費順のgolden traceが必要。
